automatic_refund.completion_rule: A refund is complete only when billing.issue_refund returns succeeded.

escalate_when: any automatic condition is not met
charge data is missing or conflicting
refund result is pending or failed
the message includes a legal, chargeback, security, or privacy risk flag
customer_communication: Never quote an amount or account state before lookup. The helpdesk tool can save drafts but cannot send them.
